issue.title: [Snappi][Enhancement]: Need proper cleanup for tgen_port_info function.

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

(1)
Function "tgen_port_info" in tests/common/snappi_tests/snappi_fixtures.py has been added recently to take care of
- adding ports dynamically to the test based on setup, without relying on variables.py.
- using variables.py

However, the function does not have appropriate clean-up function.

The function has following return parameter:
    return snappi_dut_base_config(duthosts, snappi_ports, snappi_api, setup=True)

Instead, we should yield and come back for appropriate cleanup:

    yield snappi_dut_base_config(duthosts, snappi_ports, snappi_api, setup=True)
    ## come back to this point, to clean-up the test.
    snappi_dut_base_config(duthosts, snappi_ports, snappi_api, setup=False)

(2)
Additionally, the 'snappi_dut_base_config' does not check the setup boolean variable, there-by re-initializing snappi-api, even though it is not required.

The snappi-api should be ONLY re-initialized if the setup is True.

def snappi_dut_base_config(parameters..):
         if setup:
                  ... setup the snappi API config

         return (setup_dut_ports(
        setup=setup,
        duthost_list=duthost_list,
        config=config,
        port_config_list=port_config_list,
        snappi_ports=new_snappi_ports))

@sdszhang , @auspham, @selldinesh

### Current Behavior

1. tgen_port_info now requires clean-up code to be called explicitly.
2. snappi_dut_base_config initializes snappi-api config although setup is 'False'.

### Proposed Behavior

1. yield in tgen_port_info for test-startup and come back and call snappi_dut_base_config with setup=False.
2. Initialize snappi-api in snappi_dut_base_config ONLY if setup=True.

resolution.title: [snappi][master] Add test_cleanup code for tgen_port_info infra function
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

The tgen_port_info infra function in common/snappi_tests/snappi_fixtures.py is used to select port (dynamically or statically) for the test. During static port selection, the variables.override.yml file is used to select Rx and Tx port for the test.

However, after the test, there was no explicit test clean_up code. This PR addresses it.

Summary:
Fixes #20993

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505
- [x] 202511

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The tgen_port_info is used to select the Rx and Tx port for the test.

In case of static port selection, the function returned snappi_dut_base_config(duthosts, snappi_ports, snappi_api, setup=True), and there was no explicit cleanup after the test.

#### How did you do it?
- If the 'is_override' flag is true, the static port selection code is used to select Rx and Tx ports from variables.override.yml file.
- Instead of returning with function 'snappi_dut_base_config', 'yield' is called to ensure that clean-up is called at the end of the test.
- Once yield returns back to the test, then 'setup_dut_ports' is called with setup=False to ensure that clean-up happens after the test.

#### How did you verify/test it?
For verification of this changes on 202511 branch, please refer to PR #22441
